headline: SFG @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.77 at OAK 4.42, with a projected total of 8.19. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: SFG moved -0.73 runs while OAK moved -0.06, changing the projected margin by -0.68 runs. The projected total fell -0.79, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +26.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Aaron Civale has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Rafael Devers, Nick Kurtz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Bryce Eldridge, Tyler Soderstrom because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
